passages.note: Gipson voted Aye on the Assembly floor; 31 of 79 voting members opposed, so this is not near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: the state board shall ensure that statewide greenhouse gas emissions are reduced to at least 40 percent below the statewide greenhouse gas emissions limit no later than December 31, 2030
passages.note: The operative section adds a greenhouse gas emissions limit and names no energy source.

rows.reasoning: Gipson's Aye on SB 32 (2015-2016) is an in-term record from the Assembly, but the operative section requires only that "statewide greenhouse gas emissions are reduced to at least 40 percent below the statewide greenhouse gas emissions limit no later than December 31, 2030". An emissions limit names no energy source and can be met in other ways, so it does not match the object of "Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines" (H17); it shows only the pro-action side.
